player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jwɛ̈rɛ {player_id} ka taa lajɛlɛ kɔnɔ Checkers ɲini {color}.
Kɛlɛ kelen kɔ kɔnɔ sɛbɛnɛ-fɔlɔ dondɔ [fileRank fileRank], nɔgɔ. '[b2c3]' (kɔlɔn kɔrɔ a–h, kɔlɔn sɛgɛ 0–7).
Kulujulan na:
  • Sɔrɔ kɔnɔ kɔlɔn kɔnɔnɛnɛ fɔlɔ kelen ye kɔlɔn kɔnɔnɛnɛ ma.
  • Dɔrɔ kɛlɛ ka jɔnɔ kɔnɔnɛnɛ kɔlɔn kɔnɔnɛnɛ kan.
  • Kɛlɛ kelen ye Fama ye kɔlɔn kɔnɔnɛnɛ kɔlɔn kɔnɔnɛnɛ kɔnɔ.
